$comment: SRP Class Schema (Sealed) - The always-callable runtime preprocessor class definition
title: SRP Class Schema v1
description: SRP (System Runtime Preprocessor) is an always-active runtime layer that preprocesses the system's next state continuously.

state.description: Initial state (authoritative baseline). This is the Wo-plane seed.

reducers.description: Directive list applied during collapse. Replaces imperative handlers.

projector.description: Projection specification. UI is derived from state, never mutated directly.

event_types.description: Allowed event types that can trigger reducers

@axioms.A1_always_callable: SRP is active whenever the runtime exists (boot → shutdown). No request-only activation.
@axioms.A2_structure_first: Execution consumes structured directives, not text scripts.
@axioms.A3_no_implicit_effects: Only declared transitions are allowed. Every effect is routed through a controlled surface.
@axioms.A4_determinism: Given the same input state + event, SRP produces the same next state.
@axioms.A5_projection_law: UI is a projection of state. SRP does not mutate DOM; it changes state and the UI follows.
